lighting.light_consistency_qa: Each subject must be legible in grayscale with plausible source, fill, rim, atmosphere; typography overlays deterministic; actual full-resolution generated-image QA required.

image_generation_policy.background: canon-safe cinematic scenes and motivated lighting
image_generation_policy.forbidden_in_generated_raster: No generated team names, record numbers, source percentages or readable copy
image_generation_policy.exact_overlay: Separate deterministic typography pass after rendering
image_generation_policy.must_preserve_identity: each canonical character crop SHA and Atlas structural plate

overlays.narrative_body: Slob plants his boots beside the rough training ground, where the foothill camp has seen confidence become embarrassment before. At six wins he owns the first seed, not the first gate. El Niño waits immediately; three divisional rematches follow. He grips the worn railing, surveys the yard and returns to work. A road that looks easiest from above can still throw a man down.
overlays.math_scope_note: Still alive after a Week 11 loss; no berth clinched at Week 10.

lighting.air: dry dust from known training ground

overlays.narrative_body: Wind bends the rain across the Storm Bowl. El Niño can answer it without letting it dictate the score. Slob stands ahead of him and also directly across the Week 11 field; then come three Pizza rivals, each carrying a history of unfinished encounters. A perfect sky is not required. A perfect ending is not promised. He raises a hand to the rain and chooses the next battle.
